summary: We are seeking an experienced Digital Consultant with background in GenAI platforms and emerging technologies. The ideal candidate will provide strategic consulting for Generative AI (GenAI) solutions and low code platforms.
responsibilities: Assess business needs and recommend suitable GenAI and low code solutions.
Assess current digital maturity, analyze needs, and design comprehensive roadmaps for digital transformation, linking tech to business objectives.
Use data to identify opportunities, track performance, and make data-driven adjustments to strategies for better ROI.
Collaborate with business and IT teams to gather requirements and deliver tailored solutions.
Conduct workshops and training sessions for stakeholders on low-code and AI capabilities.
Act as a trusted advisor for digital innovation initiatives and oversee the adoption of new tools
Stay updated on emerging technologies and trends in automation and AI.
Provide insights and recommendations for continuous improvement.
benefits: opportunities to work with a global team
time off/Paid holidays and parental leave
continual learning through the Learn@Siemens-Energy platform
